LadderStart.description:
`POST` [`START_PATH`]: start an agent here under a ticket. The board, the
rung, the issue and the recipe must be the ticket's.

allow.description: Tools it may use without asking (`Read`, `Bash`, ...).

permission_mode.description:
The permission mode its session starts in (Claude Code's `auto`,
say), as `start_agent` takes it: never one that skips every check.
None: Claude Code's default, a card for each command it asks.

repo.description:
The repository it works in (`owner/name`): the target finds its own
clone and opens the agent in a new worktree there. None: the target's
home.

session.description: A name for its session there; default the rung and the issue.

title.description:
Its block's title there; default its session's name. A block with a
title is one a post naming its session reaches (the board's thread,
for a lead).

user_settings.description:
The person's own Claude Code settings on the target (its allow and
deny lists, default mode, CLAUDE.md), without their hooks.

said.description:
What the target says of its row or its lead: the boards it's on, or
why it isn't.

LadderStop.description:
`POST` [`STOP_PATH`]: close an agent block a ladder start opened on the
target.

said.description:
What became of its worktree, and whether control was told it closed
(its grant's slot is free once it was).

Rung.description: Which rung of the ladder the agent is.

oneOf.description:
The board's lead: it takes the board's lead, so the board's thread
reaches it.

An issue agent: it's attached to its issue's row and holds it, so the
issue's thread reaches it.

board.description: The board, and its project: where the block is attached.

from.description:
The calling machine's id: the target refuses it from a channel whose
caller is another machine.

grant.description:
The board's grant the start counts against; none for a lead the
person's own approval starts.

jti.description:
Unique to this ticket: the target takes it once, and names it when it
attaches the block, so control counts the start.

sub.description:
The person's account: the target refuses another account's (across
accounts it's a task and its card, aru-050).

expires.description: When it runs out, in seconds since the epoch.

StartTicketAsk.description: What a daemon asks the hub a start ticket for.

issue.description:
The row's issue, as the caller writes it (`#N`, `owner/repo#N`,
`IDENT-N` or an `iss_`/`fi_` id), for [`Rung::Issue`].

recipe.description: The recipe the agent wears; none for plain Claude Code.

to.description:
The target machine's id: the asking machine's own, or another of its
account's.

StartedBy.description: Who started a ladder agent: the calling session, on its machine.

machine.description:
The calling machine's name, filled in by the target from the
channel's caller (what the caller sends here is ignored).
